messages:
maria_fin: Heads-up: INV-8342 (ThermaLabs) attempted pay with corporate card and got 'issuer-country mismatch - AVS failure'. Customer onboarding in 48h.

gwen_ae: On call with them now. They can provide PO and want to avoid a wire if possible. Issuer says card is fine but AVS rules block us.

sam_ops: Decline code from gateway?

maria_fin: Stripe webhook: `avs_phone_mismatch` / code `AVS-CR-77`. Attempt at 2026-03-25T11:03Z.

nora_se: That's consistent with our rules that require phone+address match for corporate cards. Short-term we can accept manual verification: upload PO + card authorization letter showing last4 and cardholder name. Longer term, we should detect card-issuer country != billing country at checkout and show wire/ACH prompt earlier.

devon_support: Customer (tim_cust) responded: "We can send PO and signed card authorization PDF. Can you hold onboarding until payment clears?"

maria_fin: I'll pause automated retries and set invoice tag `manual-verification`. @devon_support ask them to upload docs to support portal and attach to the invoice.

payments-bot: Auto-retry paused (retry id rty_234567). Suggested manual_collect job created: `manual_collect_8342`. Reminder: if you accept manual verification and mark paid, cancel retry to avoid duplicate capture.

gwen_ae: If customer prefers not to upload docs, offer Plaid Instant ACH (US banks) or send wire. If we take wire, waive one-time processing fee. Which do we prefer?

maria_fin: Prefer Plaid where available for speed. If customer bank not eligible, wire is fallback. Please send both options; include wire reference INV-8342 and bank details.

devon_support: Drafting message: "Hi Tim  we can accept Plaid instant ACH (link) or a wire. If you choose Plaid, authenticate and we can settle same-day. If wire, please include INV-8342 in reference and upload PO + signed authorization here: https://support.redwood.ai/portal/upload. Wire details: Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Bank: First Coast Bank; Account: 987654321; ABA: 021000021; SWIFT: FCBUS33."

tim_cust: I'll try Plaid first and upload the PO. Thanks.

sam_ops: Follow-up action items: 1) Add telemetry to log issuer-country vs billing-country mismatches for 30 days, 2) Add conditional UI hint on invoices when mismatch risk detected, 3) Create a single-step support template for manual card authorization to speed ops.

nora_se: I'll raise the router rule to flag these mismatches for manual review and file a small UX ticket.

maria_fin: Great. I'll monitor the support doc upload and mark invoice paid when settlement posts. :thumbsup:
